_meta.description: Cantor subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: buff duration, offensive hymns, protective support.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la duree des buffs de 1.2% et l'efficacite des buffs de 0.3% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases buff duration by 1.2% and buff effectiveness by 0.3% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente les degats de sorts de 0.8% et la penetration magique de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases spell damage by 0.8% and magic penetration by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la reduction de degats de 0.8% et le Souffle max de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases damage reduction by 0.8% and max Breath by 0.5% per level.
